answer: Commit-reveal bond: each agent files a quill-signed hash of its work in the river ledger for 40 credits. At reveal it publishes the preimage; the ledger accepts only the hash filed by that key, so a copied whisper from a reveal-copy ring is rejected and its 40 credits burn. 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits and file 1,000 hashes; each honest agent files once and keeps its bond. Anyone can recompute a hash from the ledger to check a reveal.
